text: {"lessons":["My account value rose over these periods, but a few months of gains do not prove that my trading decisions caused them or will keep working; I should judge progress over the long term.","I should keep a diversified portfolio and avoid adding to positions or selling solely because of recent price moves; selling Stock C at a gain does not guarantee I timed it well.","For my ten-year apartment goal, I should invest consistently, preserve enough cash for flexibility, and make trades within a clear plan rather than reacting to daily fluctuations."]}
